notes.title: New Update (04/08)
notes.notes: [p]Hello Skibidi's, Brainrot Kart has a new update again.[/p][p][/p][p]Here is all the new stuff added + bug fixes:[/p][h1]New Karts[/h1][p]There is now 2 new karts in the game, launch the game and find out what they are👅🔥[/p][p][/p][h1]New items[/h1][p]There is 6 brand new items including:[/p][p]Low Taper Fade[/p][p]Super Idol[/p][p]Goofy ahh video[/p][p]Bing Chilling[/p][p]Satisfying Video[/p][p]Don Pollo[/p][p][/p][h2]New Achievements[/h2][p]There is 2 new achievements, go get them you sigmas[/p][p][/p][h2]Linux Support[/h2][p]Linux should now be supported with this peak game, if you encounter any issues please join the discord or make a disccusion on the community hub.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes + Changes[/h2][p]Fixed a couple of bugs with the cameras[/p][p]The Backrooms has new music[/p][p]Projectiles now go through objects such as the checkpoints and doesn't bounce off[/p][p]There is now usernames above player's karts[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello Skibidi's, new update for Brainrot Kart[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Lobby List[/h1][p][b]There is now a lobby list browser meaning you can find public lobbies that are available (if you don't see any, try changing your server region)[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]New items & bug fixes[/h1][p][b]There are 3 new items in the game:[/b][/p][p]Eye Of Rah[/p][p]Property in egypt[/p][p]Locked In Alien[/p][p][/p][p]All items sounds now play correctly[/p][p]Flashbang item now works (it will flash all other players)[/p][p][/p][h1]Changes to projectiles[/h1][p][b]You can now throw projectiles backwards by looking behind you (default key: alt) and then using item.[/b][/p][p][b]Projectiles are now faster[/b][/p][p][/p][h1]Timers[/h1][p][b]Timers are now in the races and shows times for each lap.[/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/BuzJb2Z.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the delayed update, we just had to get the matchmaking system up and running again.[/p][p][/p][p]Please join the discord and follow socials below[/p][p][/p]
